## Invitations

A total of 1466 people were invited to participate in the River Districts outreach activity. Attendance was 83, representing a rate of 5.7 per cent. This level of attendance is recorded against the total number of invitations issued and provides the basis for assessing engagement during the reporting period.

The invitation process was managed through the available outreach arrangements, with efforts made to support attendance where local conditions permitted. Van days were retained where roads allowed, helping maintain access for communities across the district. These arrangements were used alongside direct contact with invited people.

## Contact

Of the invitations issued, 1263 were sent with an SMS. This provided a direct channel for sharing invitation information and supporting awareness of the activity. No people received a reminder message, with the recorded reminder total being 0.

The contact approach therefore relied on the initial invitation and associated SMS communication. Attendance and contact figures have been recorded for monitoring and future planning. The report was prepared by G. Evans.
